title: French Toor Dal Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup inspired by French cuisine, made with toor dal and a blend of zesty spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the toor dal, vegetable broth, and middle eastern spices.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the dal is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying meal.
Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
